title: Crash when invoking nvim_cmd with no args (segfault)

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.8.0-dev+177-gaf55915f5

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

N/A

### Operating system/version

macOS 12.3.1

### Terminal name/version

Alacritty 0.10.1

### $TERM environment variable

screen-256color

### Installation

Manually compiled

### How to reproduce the issue

```
nvim --clean whatever
:lua vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd("BufWritePost", {callback = function() vim.api.nvim_cmd({cmd = "update"}) end})
:w
```

### Expected behavior

Callback is executed.

### Actual behavior

Neovim crashes.
